seen: A sponsored mom-blogger video (marked AD) for a personalised sterling silver heart locket: her daughter chose the photos, including their cat Ollie who died in July. Slow close-ups open the locket on a denim pouch next to purple flowers, and the post says it is on her Holiday Gift Guide. Emotional, gift-led and seasonal.
